cohort: 100 intramural term asphyxiated neonates at the Government Thoothukudi Medical College and Hospital
finding: Higher nucleated red blood cell (NRBC) counts were associated with increased severity of hypoxic-ischaemic encephalopathy (HIE), seizure occurrence, and mortality in asphyxiated neonates.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was significantly different among the outcome groups.
